title: Introduce Inference Schema Family with Dependency-Aware Caching
description:
Add a fourth schema family — 💡️inference: all information that can be inferred from a snapshot — to every artifact schema (snapshot/diff/mutations already exist; inference is new). Full facet parity with the existing families (rs/ts/graphql/json/proto + 📝️text 8-leaf grammar tree + 💾️binary 6-leaf protocol tree per owning subset). Ship an optional, configurable caching engine with full dependency support: content-addressed per-entity merkle dependency-hash chains + diff-driven tier-1 invalidation gating, config surface (enabled/budget/persistence), and an optional db_projection-backed checkpoint adapter. Canonical worked example: flatPosition (plane + center) per object in puzzle/trinity/block-style graph artifacts, invalidated only when parent position, parent vortex, or the object's own vortex changes — per the closed-ticket merkle design at 26/04/17/OPTIMIZE-FLATTEN-DESIGN-WITH-MERKLE-HASH-CACHE. Also fixes existing anti-patterns: puzzle-5d's flatten_snapshot_inplace writing derived poses into the persistent snapshot, and trinity's recompute_derived writing flatPosition into the authored PropertyBag with 6 full-clone-and-recompute call sites.

Full design plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/introduce-inferences-to-every-elegant-reddy.md — read it first. Scope: framework spine (new Inference/DiffRegions/InferredField traits in 📡️spr, new StateClass::Inferred, descriptor changes in 🧬️schema + kernel wire, new 💡️inference OS module for the cache engine, ArtifactInferrer trait), taxonomy.json + ~10 script.ts policy changes (seed-then-shrink allowlists, never hand-counted), two pilot plugins (puzzle incl. 5d snapshot slimming, trinity incl. PropertyBag cleanup), then a ~107-subset fan-out across all plugins (stdio serial due to shared glue.rs, everything else parallel batched per-plugin), then a final tighten wave flipping the descriptor field from optional to mandatory. Coordinate with the open ARTIFACT-SYSTEM-OVERHAUL-REAL-CODECS-RUNTIME-REUSE-EVOLUTION ticket (26/08/10) which owns the same stdio snapshot/codec leaf surface — treat its snapshot leaves as read-only inputs.
summary:
Introduced `💡️inferences` as the fourth schema family (alongside `📸️snapshot`/`🔺️diff`/`🧬️mutations`) on every owning artifact subset in the repo, with dependency-aware merkle caching where the derivation warrants it.

## Result

- **112 `💡️inferences` families — 100% owning-subset coverage**, across 33 plugins. Zero owning subsets missing one.
- **0 leaf gaps**: every family carries 5 root leaves + `📝️text/` (8) + `💾️binary/` (6) + ≥1 emoji-slug dir with `🦀️component.rs` and a real `🟦️component.ts`.
- **213 files carrying inference law tests**; **223/223** glue `#[path]` mounts resolve.
- **11 families use `InferredField`** (real merkle dep-hash chains); **101 use a pure-fn leaf**.

## Framework spine (session 1)

`protocol::Inference`/`DiffRegions`/`InferenceSpec`, `StateClass::Inferred` (+ `#[state(inferred)]` in both hand-duplicated derive copies), the `os_inference` module (`DepHash`, `InferredField`, `InferenceCache`, `infer_field`) with 13 law tests, `ArtifactInferrer`, and the sibling `ArtifactInferenceDescriptor` registries.

## Anti-patterns removed

- **trinity**: created `🎛flat-position/` (the plan wrongly assumed it existed), porting the BFS/seed layout out of `Graph::recompute_derived`; deleted that method, its two helpers, `DerivedPropertyReadonly`, its mutation guard, and the manifest's `flatPosition` "derived" declaration; converted 10 distinct call sites across 9 files.
- **puzzle ◻2d** (last non-stdio gap) and **fem** both gate green under `--all-targets`.

## Six real bugs fixed, none in the assigned scope

`🏭️process` and `🪐️space` — `Inference` trait imported inside `mod tests`, so `impl Default`'s `Self::infer` did not compile. The second was found by grepping for the *pattern* rather than waiting for the compiler to reach that crate; it would have failed the moment anyone built space. stdio `🌐️html`/`🔣️json`/`📄️pdf 1.4` — `#[derive(Default)]` disagreed with honest compute over a non-empty `Snapshot::default()`, breaking `inference_default_law`; replaced with the definitional `default() == infer(default())`. stdio `📝️md` — the *test* was wrong, not the code.

Also corrected the dwg schema-id collision: ac1018's facet is authored directly in the post-fix shape (`s.stdio.dwg.ac1018.inference`), so the collision ticket never has to touch our files.

## Policy, taxonomy, discovery

- **`📜️script.ts`**: `//#region 🔧️PolicyRuleInferenceFamily` — 6 rules (family-root completeness driven off taxonomy, slug-leaf presence, impl-or-pure-fn presence, per-family-tree emoji uniqueness, assembly coverage, `#[state(inferred)]` placement). **24 breaches, 0 high**; registered at `dissolveBreaches` only. 4/4 spot-checks were true positives.
- **`🔣️taxonomy.json` flipped**: `schemaChildDirs` and `taxonomyLeafParentDirs` += `💡️inferences`, plus the grammar/protocol and schema-spec filename entries. High breaches went **24802 → 24801**; `stdio-artifacts/schema-representation` unchanged at 2. Since `policySchemaRepresentationBreaches` is allowlist-free and hard-gating, its silence across all 112 subsets is the strongest available proof the fan-out is complete.
- **`🔍️discovery/🟦️component.ts`**: added the `💡️inferences` branch, and fixed `isEmojiPrefixedSlugDir`, which required a U+FE0F variation selector and therefore rejected most real slug dirs as undeclared — **including the existing mutation slugs `📄set-snapshot` and `➕create-node`. That fix benefits mutations, not just this ticket.**

## Key design ruling

101 of 112 families use a pure-fn leaf rather than `InferredField`. A contradiction between the ticket's own rules and the approved plan was escalated and resolved: **pure-fn is legal; `InferredField` is required only where the derivation is genuinely per-entity and DAG-shaped**, because a merkle dep-chain over a flat snapshot costs more than the fold it caches. Consequently `cache_transparency`/`incrementality` laws are proven at the spine and in the puzzle3d pilot rather than manufactured as 101 vacuous per-family tests.

## Verified vs. ungated — stated plainly

**Compiler-verified green:** `semio-s-plugin-fem` (`--all-targets`, 8/8 tests), `semio-s-plugin-puzzle` (`--all-targets`, 0 errors), `semio-s-plugin-trinity` lib.

**Authored and structurally verified, gate blocked on others' in-flight work:** stdio's final `--all-targets` gate last measured 9 errors, **all** in a peer session's `🧿️semio/✳️mesh` mutation vocabulary. **Zero errors in any `💡️inferences` path on any run.** trinity's `--all-targets` was blocked by a stale import in another ticket's mutation-law code (since fixed by its owner).

`verify gate` fails at the **pre-existing dependency-cruiser step** (`ui-no-framework-packages`, unrelated framework UI modules), which a peer independently demonstrated is structurally prior and fails identically before and after their own change. It never reaches our rules.

## Deferred, deliberately

1. **compose's `flat_positions_cache` — NOT retired.** `cargo check -p semio-compose-rs` → 93 errors, all pre-existing and unrelated (`os_vcs` symbols, `dsl` absent from crate root), so any edit is unverifiable. It is also not a mechanical retirement: compose caches its own `Kit`/`Design` geometry and uses no plugin `XSnapshot`, so conversion means porting the OS cache into a foreign type system.
2. **`InferencePersistence::Projection`** — blocked on the separately-broken `semio-framework-os-kernel-db` crate (task_9a4155cc). Config-surface enum placeholder ships.
3. **`📦️packages/🟦️typescript/📦️index.ts` exports — cancelled, not skipped.** 517 of 567 export paths in those barrels already point at non-existent files (pre-standards paths against a migrated tree) and no policy enforces the file. Reported to peers as unowned repo-wide debt.
4. **Mixed binary-magic convention** — 100 families share `0x8953f83f7d340d0b`, 12 mint mnemonics. Cosmetic; nothing dispatches on it. Recorded rather than churned.

`✳️brep`/`✳️drawing`/`✳️mesh` under `🧿️semio` were authored by the peer session dissolving those engines, by agreement.
